baseline_models.focus_anchor: قَرِينُهُ ... مَا أَطْغَيْتُهُ ... كَانَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍ بَعِيدٍ
baseline_models.mechanism: A paired associate denies causing a boundary-crossing event and contrasts that denial with the person's already-present state of remote deviation.

activation_trace.role: The paired companion supplies the attached speaker whose causal liability is at issue.
Crossing the limit in rebellion supplies the act the speaker denies causing.
Presence in time makes the alternative an existing state rather than a newly caused act.
Deviation from guidance supplies that state's direction.
Distance from nearness extends the deviation beyond a momentary lapse.

changed_reading.before: The companion says he did not mislead the person, who was already badly astray.
changed_reading.after: The line separates causal production from prior condition: association is admitted, but making the person cross the limit is denied and remote deviation is assigned to him as an existing state.

baseline_models.mechanism: The bond named by qarin is retained while its causal reach is contested before the sovereign shared in the address: being joined does not by itself establish authorship.

activation_trace.role: Binding one thing to another supplies association without yet deciding responsibility.
Sovereignty and mastery supply the authority before whom the bond's liability is contested.
Boundary-crossing rebellion is the companion's act whose authorship the causative denial contests.

changed_reading.after: The defense preserves the uncomfortable bond while disputing its legal reach: proximity to the person is not itself proof of producing his transgression.

context_deltas.mechanism: The seated receivers, monitored utterance, witness, and qarin presenting what is ready turn the focus qarin from a generic associate into a participant in an evidentiary chain; his denial delimits what that record proves.

activation_trace.role: Sitting in watch supplies fixed surveillance at the start of the record sequence.
Emission of speech makes each utterance the monitored unit.
Guarding and custody supply continuous preservation of that speech.
Declaration from knowledge supplies an explicit witness function.
The same companion branch recurs immediately before the focus and links presentation to defense.

structural_cues: 50:17-23 sequences paired receivers, every utterance, a driver and witness, then a qarin's prepared presentation immediately before 50:27.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies surveillance, speech custody, witness, and a qarin with something prepared; I infer that the focus qarin belongs to this evidentiary apparatus and that his denial scopes liability. A personal or demonic associate remains live.

changed_reading.before: An ordinary associate tries to escape blame.
changed_reading.after: An attached evidentiary participant concedes association and presentation of a record but testifies that the record does not make him the author of the person's transgression.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated near/far contrasts make the focus distance relational: the person remains far in error despite intimate divine nearness, while the later destination and summons are explicitly not far or near.

activation_trace.role: Distance from nearness marks the denied return as cognitively remote, establishing a non-geographic use of distance.
Nearness opposed to distance places divine knowledge at intimate range.
Negated distance marks the contrasting destination as accessible rather than remote.
A near place gives the final summons an explicit spatial counterpart to the focus distance.

structural_cues: 50:16 places nearness inside the person's bodily frame; 50:31 negates distance for the garden, and 50:41 locates the call nearby.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit near/far oppositions; I infer that their scale colors the focus adjective as response-orientation rather than unavailable guidance. The live alternative is that بعيد only intensifies ضلال.

changed_reading.before: Far error means very deep or prolonged misguidance.
changed_reading.after: Far error is alienation sustained amid extreme nearness: warning, knowledge, and summons are close, but the person is oriented away from them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier state كنت فى غفلة followed by cover removal activates the hiddenness branch of ضلال: the focus state is not only deviation but an occluded orientation exposed at judgment.

activation_trace.role: Lapse outside alert awareness supplies the prior unseeing state.
Lifting a cover supplies the reversal from concealment to exposure.
A cover of ignorance specifies what had enclosed the person's perception.
Hiddenness and absence provide the focus branch that the unveiling sequence activates.

structural_cues: The state construction كنت فى at 50:22 anticipates كان فى at 50:27; concealment is followed by abrupt unveiling.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel state grammar plus cover and removal; I infer that the hiddenness branch of ض ل ل colors the focus state. Alternatively, 50:22 describes awareness while 50:27 keeps only ordinary moral deviation.

changed_reading.before: The person was deeply morally astray.
changed_reading.after: His entrenched deviation functioned as an occluded perceptual state; the qarin's diagnosis arrives only after that hidden orientation becomes visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The person is independently labeled a boundary-crosser; the following no-dispute ruling invokes warning already advanced. The qarin's causative denial is therefore a narrow liability plea, not a denial that influence or association existed.

activation_trace.role: Independent crossing of limits mirrors طغى's excess and assigns boundary crossing to the person.
Contention between adversaries classifies the exchange as disputed pleading.
Advancing beforehand makes warning prior to the present plea.
Threatening warning supplies prior notice of the consequence.
The causative form anchors the plea specifically in who produced the crossing of limits.

structural_cues: 50:25 names the person معتد مريب; 50:28-29 immediately answer the focus speech with no-dispute, prior-warning, and no-substitution clauses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the person's label and the immediate judicial reply; I infer that they establish prior agency and constrain the qarin's plea to causal authorship. Alternatively, the qarin may be deflecting blame without a technical liability distinction.

changed_reading.before: The companion makes a general claim of innocence.
changed_reading.after: The companion contests only authorship of the boundary crossing; prior warning and the person's own transgressor status block transfer of responsibility even if association or influence is conceded.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because qarin is naturally heard as another agent; it remains branch-anchored because Q R N B009 images a self joined to the body and context places hidden self-talk beside accompanied selves. Render it only as an intrapersonal overlay, not as an identification of the speaker.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قَرِينُهُ through the النفس المقترنة branch, with مَا أَطْغَيْتُهُ as an attached inner voice's disavowal of causal authorship.

activation_trace.role: A self joined to the body supplies the exploratory intrapersonal identity of the qarin.
Hidden self-talk supplies an interior speech environment for that attached voice.
What lies within the self as inward awareness supplies the faculty-like side of the overlay.

changed_reading.before: An external companion denies causing the person's rebellion.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory overlay, an attached inner faculty disowns authorship: it was proximal to the person and spoke within him, yet his far deviation cannot be reduced to that prompting.

strongest_changes: The recording and witness sequence revises the qarin into an evidentiary participant whose denial scopes causal liability.
Near/far and unveiling contrasts turn distant error into occluded alienation maintained amid available nearness.
The person's boundary-crossing label and the no-dispute ruling make the denial a constrained causation plea rather than blanket innocence.
summary.what_was_special: The decisive activation came from grammar and sequence: كان فى repeats a prior occluded state, while the qarin's speech sits between a prepared record and a barred dispute.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet strongly links the qarin of 50:23 and 50:27 but does not explicitly define whether every qarin occurrence has one function.
The hiddenness branch of ض ل ل may color moral deviation or remain a secondary lexical resonance.
The paired-self outlier is branch-valid but identity-distant and should not displace the evidentiary-companion model.
